chat.t: Fixer, Fixer!
Do you have time?

o: I'm free, what's up?

chat.t: Wanna go on a trip with me?

o: A trip?
Where to?

chat.t: Outside Humanitas, of course!
Wandering around the city gets boring, doesn't it?

o: True, staying in the city all the time gets dull
When are we leaving?

chat.t: In two days!
We need to buy supplies first, so let's meet tomorrow!
Lafine has shared a location.
Come here in the evening!
You said you were a regular! A regular! A regular! A regular! A regular!!!!!!

o: I visit every single day, so the owner runs out barefoot when they see me

chat.t: No, that's completely different!!
A bread thief is definitely NOT a regular!!

o: But the bread looked delicious, didn't it?

chat.t: True...
My mouth is watering because the hideout is full of that sweet smell...

o: You're gonna do it next time too, right?

chat.t: Absolutely not!
Come to think of it, we didn't even talk about the schedule!
And we couldn't buy anything besides bread...

o: As long as we have enough food, that's all that matters.

chat.t: Traveling is dangerous!!
I'll prepare the rest, so don't be late!

lines.t: Humanitas Shopping District
Sorry, I'm a bit late!

Sorry to keep you waiting!
My part-time shift ended late.
Can't be helped.
Since you're late, treat me to something.
If that's all it takes for forgiveness, sure!
Anyway, we don't have time. Let's hurry!
Where to?
To buy tomorrow's food, of course!
The 30-minute clearance sale starts right now!
Please come again!
Do you... live like this every day?
Huh?
This is literal hell!
The store is packed with people, and you're furiously tapping away on a calculator just picking out items!!
And in the end, all you buy are these dried-out bread crusts!
What's wrong with dried-out bread crusts?!
They're pretty good! The more you chew, the sweeter they get!
You've clearly never had good bread before.
Allow me to show you the taste of capitalism.
Follow me!
Huh? Where are we going?
You'll see when we get there.
Butter Bloom
Woah! This place is super famous!
I've only smelled it when walking by, this is my first time inside!
Woah, look at the prices...
As it happens, I'm a regular here.
My treat, so pick whatever you want.
Really? You won't regret it?
Nope.
If you say so, don't mind if I do!
Ooh, the Mont Blanc looks so soft! Ah! The canelés smell amazing!
And...
What are you in deep thought over?
Just grab all of them.
Mmm...  But this is enough!
What, that's it?
If you say that's enough.
If I eat too much, I'll get sluggish.
In other words, you'll gain weight.
That's rude to say!
Speaking of which... are you a fast runner?
All of a sudden?
Well... I grew up in the forest, so I guess I'm pretty fast, but...
Then run!
W-Wait a second!!
You again! Freeze right there! I'm definitely catching you today!!
Waaaah!!!

chat.t: Are you awake?
You didn't stay up all night because of our trip today, did you?

o: Only kids lose sleep from excitement
Pretty sure you were the one staying up all night

chat.t: I'm not a kid either!

o: Whatever, so where should I go?

chat.t: I'll be waiting here!
Lafine has shared a location
Hey...
Were those bread crusts really that bad?

o: Tasted awful
Too dry
How could you guys eat all the bread I gave you by yourselves?

chat.t: But the hideout was filled with that sweet smell...!

o: Yeah, yeah, I bet

chat.t: Ugh...

o: And that's how all of you end up gaining a ton of weight.

chat.t: We moved around a lot today, so it cancels out!
So, let's go on a trip together next time too!

o: Well, I guess I can tag along one more time
Since we get to be all alone in a secluded place

chat.t: What are you talking about, seriously!
It's not a date! It's a trip! A trip!

o: Yeah, yeah...

chat.t: Anyway, I'll message you next week!

lines.t: Forest Path
I'm glad you made it.
I was worried you might get lost.
Only because it's me.
Anyone else would've gotten lost.
Yeah, yeah, I knew taking you along was the right choice...
Do you know all kinds of tricks too?
Tricks?
Like finding direction by checking shadow lengths and the sun's position...
Or finding your way by looking at how the trees grow.
Why bother doing all that?
I just turn on GPS navigation and follow it.
What if you lose your Quartz?!
Then I'll just lounge around at home.
I'll show someone like you the true joy of travel...!
Can't wait.
So we just walk down this path, right?
Well, of course not!
Walking down a path carved by someone else isn't real travel!
Stick close to me.
That's... not even a path!
Wherever I walk becomes the path!
Secluded Forest
Mmm...
Why are you staring so intently at the map?
Don't tell me we can't get back home?
I am NOT lost!
I was just checking which direction we should head in.
Let me see too then.
W-Woah! If you stick to me all of a sudden...
Is this even a map? Half of it's completely blank.
It is a map!
I'm drawing it by hand with all my effort as I explore!
Then it's not a map yet!
How are we supposed to know what's up ahead with this?
Don't worry about that. It's totally safe.
My intuition tells me so.
Plu?
It's a human-plu!
Huh...?
"Totally safe," you said?
"Intuition tells you so," you said?
We just gotta beat them up! Just beat them up!
Those Flurries really have no sense of timing!
Ah, I'm exhausted...
Normally, I'd run away when they swarm like this...
Why are you looking at me like that?
Did I do something wrong?
It's nothing!
Shall we head out then?
Already? We haven't even rested for ten seconds!
Well, I've been waiting a whole week for this!
I don't have time to travel on other days because of work!
If you love traveling so much, why not just travel all the time?
I love traveling, but I want to experience city life right now.
To live in Humanitas, money is a must, so I can't quit my part-time job...
And if I ever get tired of it...
Yeah, like you said, maybe I'll just go traveling full-time.
Wanna come with me then?
If I feel like it.
What a lame response.
For now, we should focus on the current trip.
Ah...! Yeah, you're right.
Let's head over that way first!
Before that, let's grab a snack.
Where's the bread I gave you?
Ahaha... Actually, you see...
None of us had eaten anything delicious in so long, so we ate it all together...
What?! So we're just gonna starve?
I knew you'd say that, so I brought this!
Don't tell me...
Ta-da! Bread crusts!
I knew it!!!!!

chat.t: It's time!
You remember we're traveling together tomorrow, right?

o: How could I forget?
Where are we meeting this time?

chat.t: Same place as last week!

o: Got it

chat.t: I really didn't expect a cliff to pop up...
If we had a rope, we could've climbed down...

o: Do we really need to go that far?
There's gotta be a path around it

chat.t: Climbing down a cliff is way more thrilling!

o: Because of the mortal peril?

chat.t: Definitely not!
Anyway, thanks for coming along again today!
Thanks to you, I got to explore that whole area

o: If you're grateful, show some appreciation

chat.t: I don't have any money though...

o: But you have something even better instead

chat.t: Mmm... fine...
I'll give you a bag of bread crusts...

o: I don't want that!

lines.t: Forest Path
Let's go this way today too.
Huh? That's the same direction as last week.
Of course. We haven't explored it all yet.
So we're only going here until we fill out the map?
Yep! Let's do our best to fill it out today too.
Secluded Forest
Ugh...
Did a bad memory come back to you?
We ran into Flurries here last week, remember?
I'm on guard in case they show up today too.
Wild Flurries?
Do you run into them often while traveling?
They pounce whenever they see a person. Or set up clumsy traps on the path.
They're seriously such a pain.
Hmmm...
Mmm... Judging by the lack of footprints or feathers around here, I guess none are around today.
Those Flurries last week... weren't they ones you had beaten up before? That's why they attacked.
W-What's with that deep look in your eyes...?
Imagination is free, right?
That's why I'm asking what kind of fantasy you're having!
The Flurries you've beaten up so far capture you and take their revenge with some this-and-that...
Hmph, like I'd ever get caught by Flurries—Waaaah~~~~!!
Secluded Forest
If I hadn't been here, you would've suffered a terrible fate.
Ugh...
Why are you glaring at me like that?
I'm your savior here.
You are, but... You ARE my savior, but still...!
Without me, those Flurries would've done all sorts of things to you.
You're better than the Flurries, sure... and you're not wrong either, but...!
Did you really have to go that far?!
When you're rescuing someone caught in a net, things happen.
Ugh...  I'll let it slide for now. At least we avoided the worst.
We have more important things to focus on.
We're going further, right?
Absolutely! We're gonna explore hard to make up for lost time!
Until night falls!
As long as no cliffs or rivers show up, our journey continues!
Usually when people say that, a cliff or a river blocks their path.
Aw, come on, what are the odds?

chat.t: Did you hear? Did you hear?
They say there's a secret lake deep in the forest!
I think it's right beyond that cliff that blocked us!

o: So?

chat.t: Let's go!

o: We'd have to climb down the cliff
Sounds like a hassle

chat.t: Are you really not gonna go?
It's a chance to see the lake with just the two of us, you know?
Sure you won't regret it?

o: Well, if you want me that badly
I'll make a special exception and go with you

chat.t: That's more like you!
Let's meet at our usual spot!

lines.t: Forest Path
Hmm-hmm!
You look excited.
Of course! It's a secret lake in the forest, after all!
There are lakes in Humanitas too.
Those lakes are way too artificial, I don't like them.
I don't really see the difference.
Aren't they basically the same?
That's because you've never seen a magnificent lake!

Sitting on glistening sand, feeling the cool breeze blowing from the forest,
and watching the moonlight reflect on clear waters is so incredible!
Let's hurry up and find it!
Secluded Forest
So how are you planning to get past that cliff?
Heh, that's why I brought something super special!
Ta-da!
It's just a rope.
I splurged and got a real long one!
You just tie this to a tree and climb down!
Who ties it?
Who climbs down?
What's with that suspicious look?
Obviously, I'll tie it and you'll climb down!
Let me tie it instead!
I'm confident I can tie it much more securely!
Oh, you and your jokes.
Trust an expert like me at a time like this!
All tied up!
Check it yourself if you don't believe me.
It actually seems pretty tight...
This should be okay...
Why do you sound so disappointed?!
It really is safe, right?
Of course! Don't wanna go down? Fine, then I'll go by myself!
Who said I wasn't going!
I'm going first!
Oh, right! By the way, how much do you weigh?
Lafine!!!
The rope...!!
Ahhh!! No way!!!

chat.t: Waaah! Oh no! Are you okay?
Don't move, no matter what!!

o: I'm fine, so calm down

chat.t: No, I am totally calm
Yeah, I'm super calm, and I'll be right down!!

o: Just don't fall

chat.t: See? We made it back safely, right?

o: Impressive
Why do you hold back that ability?
Things would've been so much easier before if you'd used it then...

chat.t: This is my last resort!
I shouldn't use it too often!
I told you. I want to travel on my own two feet and draw the map with my own hands.

o: You claimed you'd never get lost
Looks like you get lost pretty often

chat.t: Nu-uh! I usually don't!

o: Yeah, yeah, sure

chat.t: I can tell you don't believe me at all
You won't learn until you suffer a bit on the road

o: That's why I travel with you

chat.t: Really? Then whenever you feel like going on a trip, just tell me

lines.t: Secluded Forest
Waaahhh!!
Why are you falling too?!
...The rope snapped halfway.
How cheap was that rope?! Did you buy a bargain bin special...?
Th-The price doesn't matter!
As long as it does its job...
In what world did it do its job?!
They said it could hold up to 50 kg!
Never mind me... So what you're saying is, you weigh over 50 kg?
N-No, I don't!!!
The rope must've weakened after snapping once...
...Really?
Really! I am definitely not over 50 kg!
Anyway, we need to find the lake! I hear running water over there, so let's go!
I don't hear a thing.
Just trust me and follow along!
The last time I trusted you...
...I fell off a cliff?
That was then, this is now!
I'm sure of it this time!
Yeah, yeah.
Lake
It's the lake!!!
It really is here...
Ahem! See? I told you that you could trust me!
So what are we going to do now?
Now that we're at such a magnificent lake, there's obviously something we have to do.
Stare at the lake while eating bread crusts together?
After all the trouble we went through to get here, you'd be satisfied with that?
Of course we should do something special.
Exactly! Naturally, we should play in the lake together.
So first, let's get out of these clothes!
Lake
So refreshing! That was awesome!
The scenery is gorgeous, and having you by my side makes it even better.
You enjoyed it too, right?
To be honest, I'm glad I came out here.
So you be honest with me, too.
You wanna jump into the city lake too, don't you?
You don't like city lakes because they're too open, right?
N-No, that's not it! Defi-nitely not!
Then why is your face turning red?
Whatever! Let's just hurry back!
How are we getting back?
Are you planning to climb up the cliff?
I've got my ways!
If worst comes to worst, I wouldn't mind living here just the two of us.
Y-You and your jokes...
But if we really can't find our way back, I'm fine with that too!
Why are you so confident?
It's making me nervous.
What you're about to see is our little secret.
You must never tell anyone else!
Got it, got it.
This light will guide the way.
Now, shall we head home together?
